meta.title: Escape from Tarkov - Interchange layout reference (expanded 1.0 map, data checked against patches to 2026-10-29)

frame.name: interchange_m
frame.z: south positive (north = -z = top of the 2D map)
frame.y: height, game y (flat ground 21.4; mall L1 27.1; L2 36.6)
frame.origin: x_e = 0 at game x = 82.5; z_s = 0 at game z = -8 (centre of the tarkov.dev 2D bounds [[598,-442],[-433,426]])
frame.note: The 2D map is 1031 x 868 m; the playable polygon is smaller (see boundary).

transforms.game_to_frame: x_e = 82.5 - x_game ; z_s = z_game + 8 ; y = y_game (tarkov.dev coordinateRotation 180)
transforms.svg_to_frame: x_e = u * 1031/1127.6852 - 515.5 ; z_s = v * 868/947.02582 - 434 (u,v = Interchange.svg viewBox units; 1 unit = 0.914 m in x and 0.917 m in z)
transforms.aerial_px_to_frame: re3mr aerial inside interchange-3d.jpg (4800 x 2700 px, near-orthographic): x_e = -30 + (px - 1226)/2.64 ; z_s = -312 + (py - 683)/2.64 (validated against SVG roads, rails and fences within 1-3 m)
transforms.plan_px_to_frame: re3mr floor-plan panels of the same image, 2.56 px per metre (L2 panel 2.57): x_e = -30 + (px - ox)/s ; z_s = -312 + (py - oy)/s with (ox,oy) = L0 (2696,698), L1 (3488,700), L2 (4292,692)
transforms.frame_to_roblox: Roblox X = x_e, Roblox Z = z_s (north = -Z, same as Roblox forward), Roblox Y = y. Part yaw = -rot_deg: CFrame.new(cx, y, cz) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.rad(rot_deg), 0) with Size = (w, height, d); w lies along the rotated local X axis.
transforms.rot_deg_definition: angle of the long (w) side from +x (east) toward +z (south), i.e. clockwise on a north-up map; range -90..90 (so +-90 means the long side runs N-S)

accuracy.A: footprint traced from the tarkov-dev-svg-maps SVG (updated 2026-01-09) with a tarkov.dev label or floor extent within 10 m: +-3-5 m position, +-3 m size
accuracy.B: identified by matching extents, SPT spawn points or re3mr icons; or SVG geometry whose meaning is certain but whose position was read from a drawing: +-5-10 m
accuracy.C: inferred, hand-read from a plan image, or landmark-based: +-15-30 m
accuracy.D: no position source, or a description without a map: do not rely on it

caveats: api.tarkov.dev and assets.tarkov.dev returned HTTP 403 through the sandbox proxy, so no live API data: extract positions come from the re3mr 2026-01 aerial icons, rules and spawn points from the SPT server database (pre-1.0 era data, HEAD 2026-08-10).

The SVG outside layout (roads, rails, fences, camps, highway) is the expanded 1.0 map (file updated 2026-01-09). The playable area grew from 468,825 m2 (SVG 2024-06) to 680,115 m2: boundary.pre_1_0_polygon marks the old part, which is also the only part the SPT spawn data and the older sources cover. The 77 tarkov.dev labels date from 2024-02 and name only the older points; the mall floors, garage and ramps in Interchange.svg are geometrically identical (0.001 SVG units after one shift) in the 2024-06-19 and 2026-01-09 versions, and no patch note to 1.3.0.0 lists a mall layout change, so the mall data is as current as the 2026-01 plan (+-2 m).

Store footprints on L1 and L2 are rectangles I read off the re3mr plan with the SVG floor outline over it (alignment +-2 m): grade B for most L1 stores, C for the anchors and all of L2. The SVG itself draws walls and closed blocks but no room names.
Ceiling heights, slab thickness and roof height are in no source (grade D). The garage pillar grid and the interior of the Saferoom room are not drawn.
Road, hut and yard names are my own descriptors, not official names; only the 77 tarkov.dev labels and the sign names on the plans are official.

Source conflicts are listed with dates in INTERCHANGE_REFERENCE.md section 6/7/9 and in the notes of each record (V-Ex price, Killa/Tagilla chance, raid length, Scav Camp position, Hole in the Fence).
Loose loot is not in the data: SPT looseLoot.json is a git-LFS pointer (65,763,894 bytes) whose object was not retrievable, so only the static container groups (loot_groups) are known.

The PMC entry groups MallNW and MallSE are halves of the perimeter (spawns.group_rule); the 2026 spawn rings differ from the SPT sites (only 5 within 12 m), and the 1.0 strips have no SPT spawn, zone or boss data.

Key records follow the 16-key Interchange list of tarkovforge (2026); only four doors have a position on the plan (Kiba, EMERCOM, Saferoom, Object-14), the ULTRA medical room and the Terragroup container are placed without a door, and the other keys are grade D. Durability figures are tarkovforge 2026; older articles give 15 for the two Object keycards (keengamer 2020 for #11SR, theglobalgaming 2023 for #21WS).
Tagilla is on Interchange in the 2026 sources but not in the SPT file; his spawn area is only the Goshan garage (grade C).

pre_1_0_polygon.note: Closed 'Limit' polygon of Interchange.svg as of 2024-06-19 (commit 81fa164), moved into the current frame by matching the mall Floor-1 outline of that file to the 2026-01-09 file (all 94 floor sub-paths agree to 0.001 SVG units after one shift). It is the playable area before the 1.0 expansion: 248 of the 252 SPT spawn rows lie inside it and the other four sit on its west edge, 0.2-0.5 m outside. added_regions = parts of the current playable polygon outside it (raster, 1 m cells): a west strip beyond the highway and an east strip plus a notch on the north edge.

minefield_west.note: SVG 'Danger' band, red dashed. re3mr legend: yellow dotted line = MINEFIELD along the west edge. About 40 m wide (x -480..-440 in the north, widening to x -510..-470 near z 100-150).

sniper_east.note: SVG 'Danger' band, red dashed. re3mr legend: red dotted line = SNIPER, areas guarded by a deadly sniper along the east edge. About 38 m wide.

boundary.note: Playable polygon = north SVG 'Limit' polyline + inner edge of the east Danger band + south 'Limit' polyline + inner edge of the west Danger band, simplified at 0.8 m. The two top tabs (x -417..-363 and -216..-143, z to -433) hold the Railway Exfil and the Transit to Streets icons.

relief.note: Terrain height (game y) sampled from the 155 SPT spawn points outside the mall footprint (pre-1.0 database: it covers only the old playable area, boundary.pre_1_0_polygon, so the new west strip x < -199 and the new east strip x > 300 are not sampled). No heightmap exists in any source.

extracts.name: Power Station V-Ex

extracts.name: Saferoom Exfil
extracts.requirement: turn on the mall power (Power Station switch) > flush the urinal in the Burger Spot men's toilet (L2) > swipe the Object #11SR keycard (10 uses in tarkovforge 2026, 15 in keengamer 2020) at the revealed keypad > walk down the large hole/ramp (x 85, z 15-31) into garage zone C, turn left past a yellow van and the big painted "C" to the padlocked door at (132,55) > inside, close the door with the button (exfil timer 3 s). A lever inside opens the Object-14 container
extracts.notes: ground-level hidden room east of garage zone C (the SVG draws the block as solid); room size not drawn. Wiki lists it as non-single-use; keengamer (2020) says the unlocked door is on the left after the hole in the wall
extracts.source: plan icon A (re3mr 2026-01 L0 panel), wiki, ggrecon 2022, keengamer 2020, progameguides 2023; SPT: Manual, WorldEvent, 3 s

extracts.name: Scav Camp (Co-Op)
extracts.requirement: a player scav and a PMC (any) must be at the zone together; using it gives +0.25 scav karma with diminishing returns (re3mr)
extracts.notes: inside the ground-level tunnel between garage zone B/C and the Goshan garage (x 115..210, z -73..-61). Conflict: older sources put the zone at the west/highway camp (Lorathor; tarkov.dev label "Scav Camp" at (-181,-3)) or "opposite the entrance to the ULTRA supermarket" (progameguides 2023); the re3mr 2026-01 map puts the icon in the garage
extracts.source: plan icon S (re3mr 2026-01 L0 panel); SPT "Interchange Cooperation" SharedTimer 8 s, ScavCooperation

extracts.name: Path to River (flare)
extracts.internal: not in the SPT data (added 2025-11, 1.0 expansion)
extracts.requirement: a green flare fired (SP-81 flare pistol, pistol slot) straight up inside the flare zone; the countdown starts after the shot; single use per raid; the flare draws players (ingamenews 2025-11, primagames 1.0 launch)
extracts.notes: far west edge, past the highway, on the dirt road west (gravel #1 (-323,149) > (-521,79)); the re3mr text: "head down the dirt road west until exfil starts". ingamenews: the tunnel entrance is in an embankment near the railway tracks (the icon is 151 m west of the nearest drawn rail). Prima (1.0 launch): from the Railway Exfil follow the tracks south, cross freight containers used as bridges to a large camp, turn left; the checkpoint (blue container with a red star) is at the north-east corner of the camp - the icon lies 27 m west of the westmost hut of the west camp (huts #28..#38), i.e. at its north-west side, so the two descriptions disagree by about 100 m. The flare zone itself is not drawn in any source I can read
extracts.source: aerial icon H (re3mr 2026-01), tarkovforge map-guide (listed as "Path to River (Flare) (pmc)"), primagames, ingamenews

spawns.note: Source: SPT server database (locations/interchange/base.json, SpawnPointParams). This data pre-dates the 1.0 expansion (the SPT map is the old, smaller Interchange: 248 of the 252 spawn rows lie inside boundary.pre_1_0_polygon and four sit on its west edge within 0.5 m; 468,825 m2 against 680,115 m2 now): only 11 of its 25 PMC clusters (5 within 10 m) lie within 25 m of one of the 25 re3mr 2026 rings; the east-side rings (352,-302), (362,-183), (388,-107), (393,4) have no SPT cluster within 85 m. Point = [x, z, y, facing_deg]; facing_deg = 0 east, 90 south (clockwise on the north-up map), derived from the Unity yaw as yaw + 90. PMC and Coop/Group collider radius 50 m, Coop/Opposite 100 m, delay 4 s; scav, boss and pmc-bot collider radius 70-120 m, delay 40 s.

pmc_group_mallnw.note: PMCs spawned at MallNW are given the OPPOSITE corner exit (SPT: "SE Exfil" is offered to MallNW, "NW Exfil" to MallSE); MallNW = z < -250 or x < -190 (the north edge including the NE corner, and the west side down the highway to z 346) (spawns.group_rule)

pmc_group_mallse.note: PMCs spawned at MallSE are given the OPPOSITE corner exit (SPT: "SE Exfil" is offered to MallNW, "NW Exfil" to MallSE); MallSE = everything else (the east side and the south edge) (spawns.group_rule)

coop_group.note: SPT category Coop/Group (PvE co-op raid start): 22 points, all on L1 (y 27.15), x 75..98, z -124..-96, i.e. on the L1 floor around the north octagon atrium (centre 85.4, -112.9); labelled 12 MallSE / 10 MallNW but they overlap, so treat them as one start area. Position grade A, usage grade C (inferred from the category name); collider radius 50 m, delay 4 s

coop_opposite.note: SPT category Coop/Opposite: 24 ground-level points (y 21.4), 13 in the NW corner (x -28..-22, z -326..-313, facing 50, entry MallNW) and 11 on the east side (x 260..263, z 141..160, facing 191, entry MallSE); the NW group lies about 10 m outside the NW corner of the mall footprint, the east group stands on the south-east dock apron, 20-27 m east of the L0 garage outline. The names MallNW/MallSE label halves of the perimeter (MallNW: north edge and west side, MallSE: east side and south edge, see group_rule), not single corners. Position grade A, usage grade C (inferred from the category name)

scav_wave_rules.note: SPT: 9 scav waves (type assault), 0-3 per zone; max 2 bots per zone; BotMax 30; BotStart 20 s; BotStop 2400 s; non-wave groups 50 % chance of 2-3 scavs. Open zones: ZoneCenter, ZoneCenterBot, ZoneOLI, ZoneIDEA, ZoneRoad, ZoneIDEAPark, ZoneGoshan, ZonePowerStation, ZoneTrucks, ZoneOLIPark. No sniper-scav (marksman) wave exists in the SPT data. time_min/time_max are -1 (no timing); KeepZoneOnSpawn only for ZoneCenterBot; only the ZoneCenterBot wave exists in PvP, the other eight are SpawnMode pve.

loot_groups.source: SPT server-csharp database locations/interchange/statics.json (containersGroups, containers) and staticContainers.json (probability, IsAlwaysSpawn), pre-1.0 era; staticLoot.json holds 21 container templates with item and count tables
loot_groups.note: statics.json lists 823 container objects: 693 belong to 16 groups that each draw min..max containers per raid (269-325 in all), 130 belong to no group and are all marked always-spawn. staticContainers.json has 824 records (202 always-spawn, 622 rolled by a probability of 0.08-0.71, mean 0.28) and the extra one, container_Shopping_Mall_DesignStuff_00808, is always-spawn and in no statics.json group. No positions: every Position in staticContainers.json is 0,0,0. looseLoot.json is a git-LFS pointer (not fetched), so there is no loose-loot data. How the group draw treats the always-spawn members of a group is not in the data (SPT code not retrieved, grade D). Area texts are my reading of the SPT group names (grade C).
